Resolves #19366

ADR 0034 §2.3 gains item 10, *The first-run setup broker is a named broker* — the shell ADR's record of the six `shell-setup-*` capabilities the packaged shell's preload exposes for the cockpit's first-run setup card (neomjs/neo-agent-institution#384, PR neomjs/neo-agent-institution#441): their payload/result boundaries, the sender check and the two named refusals, the credential custody (item 9's window → an owner-only file under the host setup root → the file's path in ADR 0041's record), the one-writer rule with serialized record operations, and the unwired-effect behavior until the Brain's shared orchestration is pinned. The amendment follows item 8's precedent for `verifyPlane()` (#19362 → PR #19363): an anchored amendment inside the accepted record, nothing else in the ADR changes.

Evidence: L1 (static contract — a decision record) → L1 required (AC-1, AC-2); AC-3 is the consumer PR's citation. No residual.
